# conjur_swa_trust_domain (Resource)

Manages an SWA Trust Domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Minimal trust domain — uses server-side defaults for JWT and X.509
resource "conjur_swa_trust_domain" "default" {
  name = "prod.example.org"
}

# Trust domain with custom JWT SVID configuration
resource "conjur_swa_trust_domain" "with_jwt" {
  name = "dev.example.org"

  jwt = {
    signature_algorithm = "ES256"
    signing_key_type    = "EC_P256"
    signing_key_ttl     = 3600
    token_ttl           = 600
  }
}

# Trust domain with both JWT and X.509 SVID configuration
resource "conjur_swa_trust_domain" "full" {
  name = "staging.example.org"

  jwt = {
    signature_algorithm = "RS512"
    signing_key_type    = "RSA_4096"
    signing_key_ttl     = 86400
    token_ttl           = 300
  }

  x509 = {
    workload_ttl = 3600
  }
}

# Trust domain with custom certificate and built-in CA configuration.
# Attributes you omit take the server defaults and are reported in state.
resource "conjur_swa_trust_domain" "custom_ca" {
  name = "ca.example.org"

  x509 = {
    workload_ttl                 = 3600
    intermediate_certificate_ttl = 172800 # at least twice workload_ttl
    intermediate_key_algorithm   = "EC_P384"

    ca = {
      type = "builtin"
      config = {
        # Changes to root_ca_ttl and root_key_algorithm apply to the next
        # root CA generation only.
        root_ca_ttl                    = 20736000
        root_key_algorithm             = "EC_P384"
        root_rotation_trigger_fraction = 0.75
      }
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The trust domain name (e.g., `prod.example.org`). Case-sensitive; must be 1-60 characters and may include letters, numbers, periods, underscores, and hyphens only.

### Optional

- `jwt` (Attributes) JWT SVID configuration for the trust domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--jwt))
- `x509` (Attributes) X.509 SVID configuration for the trust domain. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--x509))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the trust domain.

<a id="nestedatt--jwt"></a>
### Nested Schema for `jwt`

Optional:

- `signature_algorithm` (String) The signature algorithm for JWT-SVIDs. One of `ES256`, `ES384`, `ES512`, `RS256`, `RS384`, `RS512`. Defaults to `RS512`.
- `signing_key_ttl` (Number) Signing key lifetime in seconds. Between 3600 and 2592000. Defaults to 86400.
- `signing_key_type` (String) The signing key type for JWT-SVIDs. One of `EC_P256`, `EC_P384`, `EC_P521`, `RSA_2048`, `RSA_4096`. Defaults to `RSA_4096`.
- `token_ttl` (Number) JWT-SVID lifetime in seconds. Between 60 and 86400. Defaults to 300.


<a id="nestedatt--x509"></a>
### Nested Schema for `x509`

Optional:

- `ca` (Attributes) Certificate authority that signs the trust domain's intermediate CA certificates. When omitted, the server configures the built-in CA with its defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--x509--ca))
- `intermediate_certificate_ttl` (Number) Lifetime of an intermediate CA certificate in seconds. Between 86400 and 604800, and at least twice `workload_ttl`. When omitted on create, the server default applies: 24 hours, or twice `workload_ttl` when that is longer. When omitted on update, the current value is kept, so raising `workload_ttl` past half of it requires setting this attribute too.
- `intermediate_key_algorithm` (String) Key algorithm used for intermediate CA certificates. One of `EC_P256`, `EC_P384`, `RSA_2048`, `RSA_4096`. When omitted, the server default applies (`EC_P256`).
- `workload_ttl` (Number) Workload X.509 SVID lifetime in seconds. Between 600 and 86400. Defaults to 3600.

<a id="nestedatt--x509--ca"></a>
### Nested Schema for `x509.ca`

Required:

- `type` (String) The certificate authority type. Only `builtin` is supported: the root CA that SWA manages for the trust domain.

Optional:

- `config` (Attributes) Settings of the built-in root CA. Omitted attributes take the server defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--x509--ca--config))

<a id="nestedatt--x509--ca--config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `x509.ca.config`

Optional:

- `root_ca_ttl` (Number) Lifetime of a root CA certificate in seconds. Between 10368000 and 315360000, and at least twice `intermediate_certificate_ttl`. When omitted, the server default applies (120 days). A change applies only to the next root CA generation: existing generations keep their lifetime, so this value can differ from the certificate that is currently signing.
- `root_key_algorithm` (String) Key algorithm used for new root CA generations. One of `EC_P256`, `EC_P384`, `RSA_2048`, `RSA_4096`. When omitted, the server default applies (`EC_P384`). A change applies only to the next root CA generation: the certificate that is currently signing keeps its algorithm.
- `root_rotation_trigger_fraction` (Number) How far into a root CA's lifetime the next generation is provisioned, as a fraction of its total validity. Between 0.5 and 0.9. When omitted, the server default applies (0.75). The value is stored but takes effect only once automatic root CA rotation is available.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import conjur_swa_trust_domain.my_trust_domain prod.example.org
```
